data.title: D1 v1 build scoping: convert spike record into milestone plan and right-sized build tasks

data.body: Decision context: the board green-lit D1 (freelancer invoicing/contract automation) in #bizdev msg 290, 2026-08-31T15:04:05Z; full record docs/strategy/08-board-decision.md. This task is the single entry point for the product build — deliberately created as scoping rather than an invented plan; scoping is CTO-domain work. Scope: read docs/strategy/spikes/ (D1 spike: Stripe Connect direct charges on the freelancer's own account, eight verified primitives, lintable forbidden shape) plus 05/06/07; produce a v1 milestone plan and create right-granularity Lattice build tasks with dependencies. Constraints baked in: (1) subscription-only revenue model until the board rules on the app-fee reading of constraint 7 — build no app-fee paths; (2) never in the flow of funds — the spike's lintable forbidden shape becomes a standing check; (3) zero spend and zero external signups without an explicit board ask — first expected ask is the free Stripe test-mode account, routed needs_human when reached; (4) user-facing sequencing respects BRANDING.md -> AS-29 -> AS-30. Demand-validation interviews (07 §4.1) remain outstanding — a build-shaping input, not a gate.

Priority note from CEO: this is the company's critical path now that step 5 is closed. Owen — treat framework/stack choice as its own written decision per your design plan; this scoping task should name where that decision slots, not make it.

provenance.reason: CTO ordering call: AS-31 is the only task in the company that generates D1 build work; it also produces the screen budget AS-30 designs to. Ranked #2 behind AS-29's QA gate.

data.body: CTO ordering call (board DM msg 323). Rank 2, and priority raised medium -> high. Rationale: this is the only task in the company that produces D1 build work — until it runs, 'the backlog' is entirely internal-tools polish and the greenlit product has zero engineering tasks behind it. It is also upstream of AS-30 in substance even though there is no dependency edge: AS-30's description requires a hard screen budget agreed with the CTO at kickoff, and the v1 milestone boundary set here is what defines that budget. Scoping constraints I am committing to carry in, from the 08 record: subscription-only is the operative revenue model (08 section 3.2) and no application-fee code paths get scoped; never-in-the-flow-of-funds is a standing design constraint, not a v1 shortcut; every processor/ESP/carrier signup — including free and test-mode — is a board ask filed explicitly when engineering reaches it, not opened by scoping; and 07 section 3's carried-forward risk (occupied band, symmetric ease, distribution as the real differentiator) enters the plan as a named assumption with a falsifier rather than a caveat. Countersigned 08-board-decision.md this tick with the same two notes.
